queries.customer_total: SELECT sum(amount) FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 42;
queries.range_summary: SELECT customer_id, count(*), sum(amount) FROM orders WHERE id BETWEEN 10001 AND 20000 GROUP BY customer_id;

sensitivity.mean_vs_median: The primary mean paired contrast is reported with the median paired contrast; the primary decision remains the preregistered mean.
sensitivity.order: Contrasts are stratified by which version ran first.
sensitivity.block_stability: Contrasts are compared across the first and second half of ordered block identifiers and by leave-one-block-out range.
sensitivity.failures_and_exclusions: Reports observed nonaccepted attempts and quality exclusions; compares the validated estimate with a strict exclusion of any block having a nonaccepted attempt.
sensitivity.note: These are descriptive sensitivity diagnostics, not additional confirmatory tests or a replacement for the preregistered primary analysis.

limitations: Inference is limited to the two tested PostgreSQL versions, two specified SQL queries, deterministic synthetic dataset, and measured local Docker host/configuration.
No external production workload, concurrent user population, other hardware, operating systems, PostgreSQL versions, schemas, or query distributions were sampled.
